forum.title: Guidance for Interfacing 7" 1024×600 LCD with STM32H743ZI
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Kannika and welcome to the ST community;

[AN4861](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an4861-introduction-to-lcdtft-display-controller-ltdc-on-stm32-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf) *"Introduction to LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC) for STM32 MCUs"*

*<https://www.st.com/en/partner-products-and-services/riverdi-stm32-displays.html>*

*Using Riverdi board:*

*<https://riverdi.com/fr/product/7-inch-lcd-display-stm32h7-frame-rvt70hssfwn00?srsltid=AfmBOor6JTenPNM1U1ScMpNVHtrKVtVqVj-XNgeCxwg_m1t2NYd8tHEm>*

![mALLEm_0-1779280327869.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/f8b7ca93-633c-b707-ece5-78a1be6f647f.png "mALLEm_0-1779280327869.png")

So yes it can interface 7" 1024×600 LCD with STM32H743ZI.

**PS1**: STM32H755 have the same LCD-TFT peripheral.

**PS2**: STM32H743ZI is a 144 package check if all LTDC signals are available on that package.
forum.content_text:
Hi,

We are planning to use STM32H743ZI for our project.

Our requirement is to interface a 7-inch LCD touch display with 1024x600 resolution using a 24-bit RGB interface (RGB888) through LTDC.

Can STM32H743ZI reliably support this display resolution? Also, what frame rate can realistically be achieved with this configuration?

Are there any important hardware or performance considerations before selecting this MCU?

Any suggestions or reference designs would be helpful.

Thanks.
forum.author: Kannika

scraped_replies.html:
Riverdi (among others) have a number of displays - up to 12.1" - based on H7:

https://www.st.com/en/partner-products-and-services/riverdi-stm32-displays.html

https://riverdi.com/knowledge-base/stm32-getting-started

 

ST have eval boards with 5/5.7" displays:

https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32h7s78-dk.html

https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32h753i-eval.html

via: https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32h743zi.html#tools-software
